subject: Hybrid storage fallback pilot — Pinecone + S3 mutual action plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@pinecone.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick sync: hybrid fallback pilot idea

Hey Soojin —

Great to meet at the conference last week. Our product team talked through the idea you sketched on the panel: automatic fallback from a managed vector index (Pinecone) to an S3-backed cold index when older vectors are infrequently accessed. We think there are clear cost benefits for customers with large historical corpora.

Quick Qs before we sketch a pilot:
- Do you envision the fallback being transparent to the app (same query API) or a routing decision in the app that calls a different endpoint?
- Are there constraints on tokenized embeddings storage format (compressed vs raw float arrays) that we should plan for?

We can draft a short mutual action plan (M.A.P.) and a compatibility matrix. If you want, we can loop in Sarah from Acme Consulting for initial integration work.

—Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer, Pinecone

Attachments: pinecone-ideas-aug2026.txt (note: high-level only)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@pinecone.io>, Sarah Park <sarah@acme-consulting.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync: hybrid fallback pilot idea

Ben — thanks, this is the right framing.

Short answers up front:
- Routing: prefer transparent routing at the infra/runtime layer so product teams keep a single API. Redwood should decide based on SLOs/cost thresholds. We want the SDK/runtime to return consistent latencies for hot queries and gracefully return a slightly slower path for cold hits.
- Format: we prefer a compact, quantized representation on S3 (fp16/8 or int8 quantized) with a small header that indicates original model id and quantization metadata. That keeps retrieval costs down and supports approximate nearest neighbor fallbacks.

Proposal: Redwood + Pinecone + Acme Consulting do a 6-week pilot:
1) Week 0–1: spec & M.A.P. (roles, success metrics: 95th latency under 300ms for hot, median for cold < 1600ms, cost per 1M vectors reduced by 40%)
2) Week 2–4: integration work — Pinecone adapter for Redwood runtime + S3 cold index format + small SDK change to detect fallback
3) Week 5–6: validation on a small customer dataset (we can simulate) and run quality evals

Marissa / Dev — can you confirm feasibility on runtime changes and an initial rough estimate of engineering effort?

Ben / Sarah — if you can draft a M.A.P. doc and a short tech compatibility matrix, we can attach to the PO/contract. I’m attaching a pilot MOP draft to iterate on.

Thanks,
So

-- 
Soojin Lee
Head of Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: rnwrd-hybrid-pilot-mop.pdf (draft)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@pinecone.io>, Sarah Park <sarah@acme-consulting.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync: hybrid fallback pilot idea

+1 on transparent routing. A few engineering notes:
- Runtime: we can add a routing policy layer that checks a tokenized access counter + SLO budget and routes to Pinecone index or S3 adapter. Should be ~3–4 engineer-weeks to add a feature-flagged path (core infra + tests).
- KV Cache: need to extend KV cache metadata to include a quantization header for S3 entries so we can skip decompress when not necessary. Small format bump, backwards compatible.
- SDK: minimal change; surface a hint/flag in the SDK (opt-in) so clients can opt into eventual strong consistency semantics for cold reads.

Risks: search accuracy differences between full-float Pinecone vectors and quantized S3 vectors. We should include a quick eval set in week 5 to measure recall@10 and latency tradeoffs.

I’ll sketch a rough engineering timeline and resource ask and drop it into the shared drive link.

—Dev
Principal Engineer, Runtime

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@pinecone.io>, Sarah Park <sarah@acme-consulting.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync: hybrid fallback pilot idea

Team — commercial considerations:
- Pricing model for pilot: recommend Redwood covers infra engineering time; Pinecone provides sandbox credits (>=200k vectors) and a pilot discount for production if we convert. Acme to provide integration hours (time & materials).
- Contracting: need a short SOW + an NDA addendum covering telemetry access and customer-simulated datasets. Laura — can you indicate what standard SOW template we should use and whether legal will accept Pinecone’s standard data processing annex?

I attached a quick compatibility matrix I asked the legal/ops team to prepare (pinecone-tech-compatibility-matrix.xlsx). If Pinecone is okay with telemetry sampling level 1 (no PII), legal can fast-track.

Marissa
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pinecone-tech-compatibility-matrix.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben@pinecone.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Park <sarah@acme-consulting.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync: hybrid fallback pilot idea

Thanks all — moved our internal tech lead onto this and attached a short MAP + answers to the initial tech Qs. Highlights:
- We are happy to provide a sandbox with 250k vectors for the pilot (no charge).
- We’ll publish a small compatibility adapter example that shows how Pinecone metadata (model id + dims + quant flag) can map to an S3 object header. That should keep SDK changes minimal.
- Telemetry: agree to sampling level 1, no PII. We’ll sign the DPA addendum.

Next steps per MAP (attached):
1) Parties sign the pilot M.A.P. and add SOW appendix (legal) — target by EOD Fri 2026-08-28
2) Infra tickets created and first integration PR by 2026-09-10
3) Pilot validation complete by 2026-10-09

I’ll follow up with a DocuSign link for the MAP.

—Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer, Pinecone

Attachment: pinecone-hybrid-map-aug26.pdf (final draft)
